title: Butterfly Haus brings heavy writing with a groovy sound on the new Track "Topless Tesla"
htmlContent:
Nigerian-American music star Butterfly Haus is a multi-talented Indie-alternative producer, songwriter, and recording artist who is currently making waves in the music industry, especially with the release of his recent Track, "Topless Tesla."

Butterfly Haus' new track "Topless Tesla" is the third song of his new album titled "Time Bomb Season." This new record hits the mark in excellence from the production examining indulgence in hedonistic paths and the push and pull between that lifestyle and a desire to elevate oneself and break free from old habits. The star's presence is undeniable and carries this song to its rightful destination.
